notes.title: Game managed by my studio Dreamware Games - Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
I'm now managing the game under my game dev studio Dreamware Games to utilize the build pipeline and keep the game updated and current. Also to make the game easier to patch and fix. There will be a major update coming soon:

Upgrade to Unity 6 game engine

Adjustments for better Steam Deck compatibility

A Linux build (obviously 😄)

Minor bug fixes (mostly UI and scene transitions)

Many thanks to everyone who’s played the game. Little Thea is now 7 and she’s loved seeing her first game out in the world these past few years 🙌🏻

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #6
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:

Ultra wide screens (21:9 aspect ratio):

 Correctly spawn enemies when ultra wide screen
 New backgrounds to fit across entire screen

Player death:

 Fix bug where player dies repeatedly if caught between 2 traps (like moving saw blade and fan)

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #5
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:


 Improved hit detection: check for enemy hit on every frame of attack animation.
 Fixed issue with attack range not resetting after jump attack.
 Fixed bug where game softlocks if you die on the first frame of an enemy hit.
 Fixed menu navigation bug with "Credits" locking.

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #4
notes.notes:
Fix issue on Windows with multiple shift button (attack) presses prompting sticky keys.


On Windows, when pressing the SHIFT key five times in rapid succession, it will ask if you would like to turn on sticky keys. Fixed by adding attack with Z-key also. Updated UI/tutorial accordingly.

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #3
notes.notes:
Fix issue with screen resolution and UI elements

Resolve minor issues for UI elements going out of viewport on some resolutions.

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #2
notes.notes:
Fix MacOS UI issues and improve player movement.

Following fixes and improvements added:

 Fix issue with UI elements not displaying properly on MacOS
 Add coyote time and jump buffering to player movement

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #1
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:

 Inconsistent hit detection - Issue was due to input registration, hit detection and animation all being handled in Unity's "Update" method, causing inconsistent behaviour.
 Controller support - Correct mapping of attack and pause buttons on controller.
